known_reference_discrepancies: Paper describes item frequency >100; the released preprocessing script uses >=350 and user frequency >=20 iteratively.
Released preprocessing computes a positive-feedback mask on df but continues processing df1 assigned before that filtering; do not silently change this and claim exact code reproduction.
The released candidate catalog has 131091 IDs, while the paper lists 131090 observed items. Preserve and report the difference for code alignment.
Released evaluation uses the last interaction as holdout without an independent validation set; do not select checkpoints or hyperparameters on this holdout.
Released MRR is based on Top-2500 retrieval and assigns rank 2501 when absent; it is not exact full-catalog MRR.
Portable trainer uses FP32 log-softmax and deterministic item-ID tie ordering; original CUDA interaction scoring is hardcoded BF16 and torch.topk ties are backend-dependent.
ULTRA-HSTU architecture/window settings and ID-only DARE sampled-softmax are task adaptations, not industrial-paper reproductions.

CCFormer replaces original CTR rich fields, loss and metrics with the common FuXi ID-only next-item task; triangular temporal/PFFN masks and left-padded convolution are causal adaptations, and industrial 8x256 settings become shared 4x128 settings. No original paper/author-code/production-speedup reproduction claim.
